en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the exterior of a large Romanesque cathedral with an apse, heavy stone walls, and a tall central tower topped with a cross. In the foreground there is a small fenced area and an ornate portal; adjoining buildings are visible on the right. The lower margin of the card contains printed captions in red and black, and the rest of the front is filled with handwritten cursive text.
